Quantum X Labs, a subsidiary of Gix Internet Ltd., has widened its AI‑driven quantum error‑correction benchmarking to cover additional IBM quantum processors. The updated platform reports up to 20 % fewer decoding failures than previous benchmarks, suggesting significant improvements in fault tolerance for near‑term devices. This advancement positions the company as a key player in enhancing reliability of emerging quantum systems.
